sources: AI and the Future of Work
strategies.automation: Run backfill-episodes regularly, then enqueue-transcript-backlog without YouTube/document flags. Prefer VTT, JSON, TXT, then SRT when multiple transcript tags exist.
strategies.failure_rule: Do not mark exhausted while a creator RSS transcript link exists. Retry transient failures; durable 404/410 after repeated refreshes becomes stale_transcript_link.

strategies.automation: Parse RSS description/content:encoded for official direct transcript files and explicit transcript anchors. Attach direct TXT/VTT/JSON links automatically; keep YouTube URLs in caption lane.
strategies.failure_rule: If RSS body has an official transcript file, retry fetch/parse before browser discovery. For YouTube URLs, caption_blocked is not exhaustion.
next_hardening: public Google Doc txt export for official links
YouTube caption availability tracking separate from fetch blocking

strategies.automation: Use RSS transcript/page links and official /transcript pages. Backfill from Changelog sitemap/archive only to discover official episode transcript pages.
strategies.failure_rule: 404/410 /transcript after repeated checks is stale_official_transcript; Coming Soon/no transcript remains pending or no_public_transcript based on page state.

strategies.automation: Run sync-verge-official-transcripts to poll official Verge Atom feeds while preserving Megaphone audio feeds as episode inventory. Attach only canonical Verge /podcast/ article pages whose JSON-LD articleBody is transcript-sized.
strategies.failure_rule: Short official article bodies are not treated as transcripts. Exhaust only after official archive pagination and canonical article checks show no transcript/full-content route.
next_hardening: duplicate source-id guard between Decoder aliases

strategies.automation: Use the official EconTalk episode URL and extract the .audio-highlight transcript/highlights section only. Strip standalone timestamp lines before quality checks. Do not ingest reader comments, sidebars, or whole-page boilerplate.
strategies.failure_rule: Recent pages without an audio-highlight section stay pending for the normal publication lag. Older pages with no official transcript section become official_page_no_transcript after retry.
next_hardening: bulk verified URL attach for all EconTalk episode pages

strategies.automation: Use official Stack Overflow podcast pages that expose a Simplecast transcript link, then fetch the official Simplecast transcription through the public episode API. Do not treat recent Art19 feed items without an official page/transcript link as eligible.
strategies.failure_rule: HTTP 404/410/403 remain hard failures. Blog-shell or short-parser failures may be retried only after parser/adapter fixes and an explicit quarantined/parser retry flag.
next_hardening: official archive crawler for Stack Overflow podcast pages with transcript links
negative discovery for recent Art19-only episodes

strategies.automation: Use official archives/sitemaps to map RSS episodes to official episode pages, then parse only the transcript section or deterministic transcript URL.
strategies.failure_rule: Recent missing transcript pages stay pending for a lag window. Older official pages with no transcript marker become official_page_no_transcript.

strategies.automation: Promote official RSS episode pages as transcript pages for CoRecursive and The Cognitive Revolution.
strategies.failure_rule: Fetch only official creator domains. Pages without a transcript-sized section fail closed and are not retried as generic page scrapes.

strategies.automation: Use only explicit Lex RSS transcript links until a safer archive matcher distinguishes valid legacy transcript pages from missing derived slugs.
strategies.failure_rule: Do not bulk-derive -transcript URLs across the full archive without a positive page existence and transcript-size check.

strategies.automation: For Substack podcast RSS feeds whose item links point directly to official public posts, promote the post URL as an official transcript page only when the page exposes a transcript section.
strategies.failure_rule: Pages without a public transcript marker, sign-in/paywall pages, and external mirrors remain blocked or pending; do not ingest generic post chrome as a transcript.
next_hardening: archive/title matching for Substack shows whose podcast RSS lacks post links

strategies.automation: Use official Substack podcast RSS/section/sitemap pages and parse public transcript tabs/sections only; ignore unrelated newsletter posts and external mirrors.
strategies.failure_rule: Public transcript tab missing after retry becomes official_page_no_transcript. Sign-in-only/paywalled pages are blocked, not ingested.

strategies.automation: Scan official archives for public DOCX/PDF transcript assets, but enqueue only after document-to-text parsing is enabled and quality-gated.
strategies.failure_rule: Do not fetch document assets as raw text. If official archive/page has no document transcript, record no_official_document_transcript.

strategies.automation: Match RSS episodes to official creator-channel videos by title/date/duration; use public captions only when the official channel and episode match are verified.
strategies.failure_rule: caption_fetch_blocked is not exhaustion. Exhaust only when official video has no public captions or no official video match exists.
next_hardening: caption availability probe separate from fetch

strategies.automation: Detect official gated transcript availability and report counts only. Do not ingest gated transcripts without explicit approval and a policy update.
strategies.failure_rule: Without approved auth, public preview is insufficient and stays official_gated.
next_hardening: policy flag for approved official auth

strategies.automation: Record negative official-source searches and mark transcription_eligible only after RSS, official homepage/archive, official episode page, and public creator-caption routes are exhausted.
strategies.failure_rule: Do not use Apple native transcripts, third-party transcript mirrors, app-only surfaces, or paywalled/private pages.
next_hardening: paid transcription fallback remains explicit opt-in
